_about: Narrator lines for Werewolf. Each key is a moment; each entry is one variant, saved as audio/<id>.mp3. Names are never spoken.
welcome: Welcome, travellers, to a quiet little village. Quiet... for now. Gather close, and keep your phones near.
Ah, you've arrived. Pull up a chair by the fire. Tonight, something in this village is not what it seems.
roles: Look at your phone, and hold your card to learn who you are. Tell no one. Not your friends. Not your family. Especially not your family.
Your secret role waits on your phone. Read it, remember it, and keep a straight face. The wolves are already among you.
night-first: Night falls on the village. Eyes on your own phone, and not a sound. Werewolves, choose your victim. Seer, choose someone to look into. Doctor, choose someone to protect. Everyone else, choose who you suspect.
The sun sinks behind the hills, and the village goes to sleep. Look only at your own phone. Wolves, pick your prey. Seer, seek the truth. Doctor, guard a life. Villagers, name your suspect.
night: Night falls once more. Make your choice in silence.
The moon rises over the rooftops. Eyes on your phone, and not a whisper.
Darkness again. Somewhere in the trees, something is hungry. Choose quietly.
The lanterns go out, one by one. The village sleeps. Most of it, anyway.
dawn-death: The rooster crows, and the village wakes... but not everyone. Claw marks lead into the forest.
A scream at midnight. By morning, one chair at the table sits empty.
Muddy paw prints stop at a front door that's still hanging open. The wolves have fed.
Good morning, village. Well. Good morning for most of you.
The sun rises on a terrible sight. The wolves have taken one of your own.
dawn-saved: Howls echoed through the night, but the Doctor got there first. Everyone survived!
The wolves came knocking, but a healer was waiting. Not a single soul was lost.
A close call in the dark, but the Doctor's hands were steady. Everyone wakes up safe.
dawn-quiet: A strangely quiet night. Everyone wakes up safe... which is somehow more unsettling.
was-villager: Just a simple villager. Gone too soon.
was-seer: They were the Seer. Whatever they knew, they took it with them.
The Seer has fallen. The village has lost its sight.
was-doctor: They were the Doctor. Who will protect you now?
The Doctor is gone. From here on, no one is safe at night.
was-wolf: They were... a werewolf! The village breathes a little easier.
Fur, fangs and a guilty grin. They were a werewolf!
discuss: Now talk it over. Who was too quiet last night? Who is pointing fingers a little too fast?
The floor is open. Accuse, defend, and bluff. The wolves are listening.
Someone in this room is lying to you. Find them.
thirty-seconds: Thirty seconds left. Make up your minds.
Time is running short. Thirty seconds.
vote: Time to vote. Choose on your phone who leaves the village.
The talking is done. Cast your vote.
Point your finger, on your phone. Who goes?
verdict-out: The village has spoken. One of you must leave... forever.
The votes are counted. The village has made its choice.
The crowd turns, and the decision is made. They are cast out of the village.
verdict-tie: The village is divided. A tie. No one leaves today.
Half say one thing, half say another. Nobody is cast out... this time.
verdict-none: No votes at all? The village shrugs, and night draws closer.
win-village: The last wolf is gone! The village wins, and tonight, everyone sleeps soundly.
Every werewolf has been found. Ring the bells! The village is saved!
The howling stops for good. Villagers, you did it.
win-wolves: The wolves now outnumber the village. The werewolves win.
One by one, the lights went out. The village belongs to the wolves now.
Too late, the villagers realize the truth. The werewolves win!
voice-test: Night falls on the village. Somewhere in the dark, the wolves are hungry.
